mentions.name: Kueon
mentions.description: A competitor intelligence platform for SaaS teams. Users add keywords to watch and receive alerts when those keywords are mentioned in Hacker News or Reddit discussions, and configure competitors for their SaaS to be notified when those competitors make product or pricing updates. Planned features include reducing noise from unrelated conversation mentions, reports interpreting competitor updates for the user's product, and ideas for joining relevant discussions.
mentions.problem: SaaS teams lack an easy way to monitor keyword mentions and competitor product or pricing updates across Hacker News and Reddit.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on Kueon recently, a competitor intelligence platform for SaaS teams. It currently allows you to add keywords to watch and alerts you when those keywords are mentioned in Hacker News or Reddit discussions.

Besides that, it also allows you to configure competitors for your SaaS and notifies you when they make product or pricing updates.
mentions.author: anishghimire862
